title: Leadership Lesson 2: So Goes the Leader, So Goes the Culture
coreMove: Treat your visible reaction under pressure as the lesson the culture will copy.
sourcePressure: Shows leader behavior as upstream cultural instruction: what authority models, protects, excuses, and punishes teaches the group how the place works.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making the lesson about personality, inspiration, or speeches instead of observed conduct.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: leader reaction teaches whether corrections are safe
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes the correction herself first and asks the reporter for the source trail in private
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red correction stamp beside a marked proof

exampleSpecs.audience: chef after a wrong allergy plate
exampleSpecs.stakes: staff watch whether authority blames or protects truth
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the chef kills the ticket, thanks the runner for stopping it, and only then reviews the miss
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an allergy ticket clipped above the pass

exampleSpecs.audience: lead guide hearing a junior call off summit
exampleSpecs.stakes: guides learn from what the lead protects under pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lead backs the call in front of clients before discussing route judgment
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a summit forecast taped to a bunk wall

exampleSpecs.audience: publisher tolerating a star columnist's insult
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the publisher maps three past exceptions before issuing the same standard to the star
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a column draft beside an apology letter

exampleSpecs.stakes: technicians copy the director's treatment of frustration
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director kneels to adjust the socket strap instead of rushing the next appointment
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a socket strap beside a fitting stool

exampleSpecs.audience: harbor master during a Mayday false alarm
exampleSpecs.stakes: first reaction teaches whether people report uncertainty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he thanks the caller for the early report before logging the false alarm
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a radio log under a channel marker chart

skillTargets: predict cultural lessons from leader behavior

tryThisNowSpec: Before responding to bad news, write what your first visible reaction will teach everyone watching.
sourceAnchorsNote: source contains no named anecdote for this chapter
